answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 10590 Country: AU Title: Dear Mufti sahib! i see in my dreams that i am sitting in washrooms, sometimes having doors closed and sometimes having doors open, i am discharging wastes from my body, and somebody sits or passes me, talks to me. sometimes i am without cloths. i see these types of dreams regularly. please help me out. Question: Dear Mufti sahib! i see in my dreams that i am sitting in washrooms, sometimes having doors closed and sometimes having doors open, i am discharging wastes from my body, and somebody sits or passes me, talks to me. sometimes i am without cloths. i see these types of dreams regularly. please help me out. Answer ID: 10590 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 190/143=H/1429) The dream means that you lack interest in following sunnah. Recite the below dua seven times after every obligatory salah with durood thrice before and after: أ للھم إني أسألک الھدی والتقی والعفاف والغنی Strive hard shunning from sins and do not get slackened in doing good deeds. Go to bed in a state of wudhu, recite the duas related to going to bed and waking up. Keep the bed and clothes pure as much as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
